verdict.rationale: Postman's docs state it can run scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) and after it (post-response). Scripts can add dynamic parameters and pass data between requests, which covers chaining and data massaging. Variables and environments support carrying values between requests, and collections with these scripts can run in CI via the Postman CLI or Newman. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the scripting API (e.g. how to set and read variables, which libraries are available), and independent or hands-on corroboration of request chaining.
